title: Minute Out In It: Spring Bears
licence: Public domain — work of the U.S. National Park Service (federal government). NPS media pages: items without a © symbol or non-NPS credit are public domain. Credit line recorded below.
contents: A big grizzly fresh out of hibernation forages along a snowy creek near Midway Geyser Basin, crosses deep snow and walks down a snow-covered road close to camera, then ambles past steaming thermal features. Narration by the park bear management biologist on audio.
